note: Conceptual/architecture lesson on relationship types (lookup, master-detail, hierarchical, self, junction-object many-to-many). No screenshots per this course's policy: taught through prose, tables, and a written scenario, never UI click-paths. Verified against the official Salesforce object reference page: lookup relationships have no effect on deletion/security and aren't auto-required; many-to-many is built via a junction object with two master-detail relationship fields (supported since early API versions); a roll-up summary field on a master-detail relationship blocks converting it to a lookup. No exact numeric cap on relationships per object is stated, since that figure could not be confirmed on an official Salesforce page.
